title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I want to know the meaning of two dreams: 1. I saw that arrangements are going on for my marriage. But the nikah has not taken place. I'm getting married to a girl who has revert to Islam from Hinduism. Even the girls parents are present in the marriage and they do not show any objection. 2. I saw another dream ..that two of my teeth have broken on their own. 4865 views Q. Please interpret the following dream for me. Rasulullah (SAW) is returning after being exiled from Madinah 1455 views Q. I once had a dream of darul uloom falahi daaarain from which ma teacher and dad grasduated...and i use to think about it quite often too and i also had a desire to see itt...so before i went india i had a dream of a class room in de darul uloom but was not the actual picture of the darul uloom in reality i was looking at a bunch of students and the teacher teaching and i was wearing a white kurta shalwar and shall and suddenly it started raining a lot and and i started to run in the oppossite direction of the madrasa and my dream ended..so please can u interpretate this dream. 1613 views Q. Is the dung of hen, duck and cow impure? 3389 views Q. My younger sister (cousin) dreamed that both she and her elder sister were just carrying baby 1306 views Q. Was the Prophet (saws) more beautiful than Yusuf (as)? 5009 views Q. I would like to know about a dream that I had once. It was when I was about 12 years old and it should have been after sunrise sometime. I saw myself in the night in the hospital giving birth to a son, then I remember loving the son greatly and keeping him with me. After this, I gave him to my father to look after and when I came back looking for him, he was lost and I just saw flashes of him here and there; then I started crying in the dream and woke up. I felt very strange after waking up and became attached to the idea of motherhood. I think I need the meaning of this dream, jazak Allahu khair. 1357 views Q. Dream 1583 views Q. I dreamt that it was the day of yaumul qiyamah and I was standing in a room, then my late grandmother came to me and greated me, then my great grandmother also came happy as well as my grandfather. They were happy about something, but didnt say anything. I then dreamt that I proceeded to a qabrstaan where my mother was buried, and she wasnot resurrected with the rest of us as a result of sacrifises that she had made for us in this dunya. Dream 2: My Aunt told me that she dreamt my fatherinlaw who is recently late crying and trying to tell her something. When he parted it was after our families had a huge fight, but he did tell us to make peace with each other before he went. 2758 views Q. dream interpretation 1224 views Q. Asalamu alaikum, I am eager to know what, seeing 2 of your family members go to hajj then come back can mean in a dream. Also, what does being scared that you will miss a prayer, or missing a prayer in dreams mean? Jazak Allah. 1286 views Q. Sometime back I saw a dream and I would be grateful if u could give me tabeer for the same. I saw that I am standing just outside my house in the lane. Some lions are approaching me from the other end. I am a little scared. But when they come close to me, the lions become meek and submissive. And I realise that though I was afraid of them, they are actually here to help and protect me. Soon, I see these lions stand next to me to counter the lions coming from the opposite direction. Pl guide with a tabeer. 1455 views Q. Yesterday I saw a dream about one lion and one bear, both came to attack me but I closed the door quickly 1829 views Q. islamic beliefs 1664 views Q. استخارہ 1243 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 57860 Country: India Title: استخارہ کرنے کے بعد جو خواب دیکھا اس کی تعبیر بتائیں ۔دلہن تلاش کرنے کے حوالے سے استخارہ تھا، میری پھوپھی استخارہ کررہی تھیں، استخارہ کی تیسری رات کو انہوں نے خواب دیکھا کہ ایک جانور ہے (جو تقریباً ایک بھیڑ کی طرح تھا)اورایک بڑی گاڑی نے اس کو ٹکر ماردی ، اورجانور کاسر اس کے جسم سے الگ ہوگیا، اس کے بعد پھوپھی نے استخارہ کرنا بند کردیا ۔ براہ کرم، خواب کی تعبیر بتائیں۔ Question: استخارہ کرنے کے بعد جو خواب دیکھا اس کی تعبیر بتائیں ۔دلہن تلاش کرنے کے حوالے سے استخارہ تھا، میری پھوپھی استخارہ کررہی تھیں، استخارہ کی تیسری رات کو انہوں نے خواب دیکھا کہ ایک جانور ہے (جو تقریباً ایک بھیڑ کی طرح تھا)اورایک بڑی گاڑی نے اس کو ٹکر ماردی ، اورجانور کاسر اس کے جسم سے الگ ہوگیا، اس کے بعد پھوپھی نے استخارہ کرنا بند کردیا ۔ براہ کرم، خواب کی تعبیر بتائیں۔ Answer ID: 57860 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa ID: 302-287/H=4/1436-U خواب کی تعبیر یہ ہے کہ استخارہ کرنا ابھی موقوف نہ کریں۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
